confirmation_policy.current_note: Ten confirmation tasks across five task families are protected; no model-based confirmation run is allowed before freezing.

protocol_snapshot.revision_note: v06 keeps v05 isolation and static-baseline fairness, but removes verbose adaptive reasons after call-level telemetry showed they cost more tokens than disclosure saved. The concise policy was derived from v04/v05 failures: single-step named inputs use brief, multi-step dataflow uses schema, and explicit non-Schema behavior uses full. The JSON parser also quotes unambiguous bare $input/$last_output placeholders observed in repeated dev API outputs. Confirmation remains untouched.
